value.name: Dicky visits his son in prison
value.description: Dicky sits with his young son in the visitor's room while Alice sits across from them during a crowded prison visit.
evidence: BILLERICA HOUSE OF CORRECTIONS - VISITOR'S ROOM-1ST FLOOR - DAY .Dicky playing with his 4-year-old son, sitting across from Alice smoking a Lucky, three newspapers in her lap, room crowded with convicts, visitors, thick with smoke.
value.location_hint: Billerica House of Corrections, visitor's room, 1st floor

value.name: Alice mentions the movie backlash
value.description: Alice tells Dicky that people are talking about the movie and that it makes him and the city look bad.
evidence: ALICE Everybody's talkin' about the movie, Dicky, it sounds.
They're sayin' it makes you an' the city look bad.

value.name: Dicky acknowledges the film's consequences
value.description: Dicky reacts warily and admits the situation did not turn out as intended.
evidence: It wasn't supposed to work out this way.
